workflow.edit.title: Compose a workflow
workflow.edit.body: Compose on the chart: add a step on a way, choose a step to say what happens next, and each way's kind follows from where it goes. Each change is judged as you make it; nothing is saved until you save.
workflow.edit.reading: Reading the steps a workflow may hold…
workflow.edit.unread: The steps a workflow may hold could not be read: {{why}}
workflow.edit.empty.body: No steps yet. Add the first, or begin from a preset or a workflow saved here.
workflow.edit.picker.title: Add a step
workflow.edit.picker.between: Between {{from}} and {{to}}: {{from}} goes on to the new step, and it to {{to}}.
workflow.edit.picker.at.changes: After {{from}}, if you ask for changes.
workflow.edit.picker.free: Unconnected: a new start of the workflow.
workflow.edit.insert.at: Add a step when {{from}} comes to {{outcome}}
workflow.edit.pick.started: Choose where {{row}} goes from {{step}}: {{count}} steps can take it. Enter picks, Escape gives it up.
workflow.edit.pick.none: No step can take where {{row}} goes from {{step}}.
workflow.edit.inspector.none: Choose a step to see what happens next.
workflow.edit.next.title: What happens next
workflow.edit.next.pickNamed: Choose on the chart where {{row}} goes from {{step}}
workflow.edit.next.newNamed: Add a new step where {{row}} goes from {{step}}
workflow.edit.carries.title: Carries
workflow.edit.carries.label: What {{step}}'s input {{input}} is given
workflow.edit.carries.none: No step here makes what it takes.
workflow.edit.more.title: More ways
workflow.edit.more.trigger: Each time it is reached, start…
workflow.edit.more.triggerLabel: Start a step each time {{step}} is reached
workflow.edit.more.join: How the ways into it join
workflow.edit.more.joinAll: Waits for every way into it
workflow.edit.more.joinAny: Goes on at the first way into it
workflow.edit.more.joinRecorded: The ways into it join by groups kept as written.
workflow.edit.move.cannot: It has more than a chain's one way into it and one way on, so it moves by its ways.
workflow.edit.remove.says: Remove {{step}}? Its ways go with it, and nothing is joined unless you choose.
workflow.edit.remove.end: Where the work is done instead
workflow.edit.said.pasted: Pasted {{steps}}; ways to steps not copied left out: {{dropped}}.
workflow.edit.said.joinAll: {{step}} waits for every way into it.
workflow.edit.said.joinAny: {{step}} goes on at the first way into it.
workflow.edit.unknownKind: A step this page has no words for: `{{kind}}`
workflow.edit.way.back.rejected: Back to {{to}}, when you ask for changes
workflow.edit.way.back.outcome: Back to {{to}}, when it comes to `{{outcome}}`
workflow.edit.role.label: Its role
workflow.edit.role.none: No working role here does this step's work.
workflow.edit.judge.holds: These steps hold, and can be saved.
workflow.edit.save.title: Save
workflow.edit.save.idSays: Saved as `{{id}}`, made from its name.
workflow.edit.save.name: Its name
workflow.edit.save.appendSays: Saving adds v{{version}} to {{id}}; work already running keeps the version it started on.
workflow.edit.save.reach: Each new start in these places follows the version you save:
workflow.edit.refusal.no-id: A way on here has no id.
workflow.edit.refusal.wire-twice: Two ways on share one id.
workflow.edit.refusal.node-twice: Another step has this step's id.
workflow.edit.refusal.unknown-kind: Daoris here knows no such kind of way on.
workflow.edit.refusal.shape: Its ends do not fit its kind.
workflow.edit.refusal.no-outcomes: Its step comes to no named result, so this way is never followed.
workflow.edit.refusal.unknown-outcome: Its step does not declare that result.
workflow.edit.refusal.foreign-node: It names a step of other work: other work is waited on by a step of its own.
workflow.edit.refusal.missing-node: It names a step that is not here.
workflow.edit.refusal.missing-port: It names an output or an input its step does not declare.
workflow.edit.refusal.incompatible-schem: What it carries is not what the next step accepts as input.
workflow.edit.refusal.not-wait-unit: A wait goes only into a step that waits on other work.
workflow.edit.refusal.wait-target: What it waits on is not said whole.
workflow.edit.refusal.wait-twice: This step waits on two things at once.
workflow.edit.refusal.input-unfed: An input of this step is given nothing: each input needs a way on with what a step made.
workflow.edit.refusal.grouped-input: An input is in a group, and every input is needed.
workflow.edit.refusal.group-mode: Its group is not said whole.
workflow.edit.refusal.group-split: Its group gathers ways into more than one step.
workflow.edit.refusal.grouped-member: Its group does not hold here.
workflow.edit.refusal.never-fails: Nothing can fail this step, so this way is never followed.
workflow.edit.refusal.never-rejected: Nobody can refuse this step, so this way is never followed.
workflow.edit.refusal.cycle: These ways on come round to where they began: go back by Back to an earlier step instead.
workflow.edit.refusal.back-forward: A way back goes only to a step that comes before this one.
workflow.edit.refusal.back-twice: This step already goes back on that.
workflow.edit.refusal.back-never: This step can never go back on that.
workflow.edit.refusal.unreadable: These steps are not a workflow's shape.
workflow.edit.refusal.schema-version: Daoris here reads no such schema.
workflow.edit.refusal.nodes-bound: There are more steps than a workflow holds.
workflow.edit.refusal.wires-bound: There are more ways on than a workflow holds.
workflow.edit.refusal.synthetic-bound: Too many steps are made from these.
workflow.edit.refusal.declaration: This step's declaration does not hold.
workflow.edit.refusal.landing-kind: After the landing, another step of a landing's kind is one too many.
workflow.edit.refusal.into-landing: A step after the landing leads back into it.
workflow.edit.refusal.entry: A start names no step, or one twice.
workflow.edit.refusal.entry-wired: A step that starts the workflow has a way into it.
workflow.edit.refusal.end: Say which step ends the work.
workflow.edit.refusal.end-kind: The agent's work cannot be where the workflow ends.
workflow.edit.refusal.unreachable: No way from the start reaches this step.
workflow.edit.refusal.protected-order: The second opinion and your look come before the landing.
workflow.edit.refusal.protected-wire: Each gate needs a way straight on to each later gate.
workflow.edit.refusal.observed-twice: Two steps watch for one plugin step's event.
workflow.edit.refusal.close-end: Where the quest's close is a step, the work ends at it.
workflow.edit.refusal.after-close: Nothing comes after the quest's close but the way it takes if it fails.
workflow.edit.refusal.closure-deadlock: The quest's own done is needed before its close, which never comes first.
workflow.edit.refusal.cleanup: Its clean-up is not one Daoris reads.
workflow.edit.refusal.integrate-unlanded: An integration needs a landing to integrate.
workflow.edit.refusal.integrate-plugin: A landing by a plugin is not integrated.
workflow.edit.refusal.before-landing: This step can be reached before anything has landed.
workflow.edit.refusal.work-requests-twic: The work's requests are held once.
workflow.edit.refusal.work-requests-uncl: The work's requests come after the work.
workflow.edit.refusal.work-requests-late: The landing can start before the work's requests are answered.
workflow.edit.refusal.land-tail: The steps after the landing are not what its method brings.
workflow.edit.refusal.role: Its role does not do this step's work.
